about_the_game:
Something is wrong in this forest resort. You are plunged into a relentless nightmare, mixing action and horror, where the line between hunter and prey is terribly thin.

You play as a man or woman busy dealing with the last visitors of the season. But suddenly, something emerges from the depths of the woods: werewolves.

You are the last line of defense against a pack of savage and intelligent werewolves prowling the dense, moonlit forests and the ruined structures hidden within.

Resources are cruelly scarce. Every bullet counts, every first aid kit is precious. Search for supplies, manage your dwindling inventory, and make agonizing choices: when to fight, when to hide, and when to flee.

  • Distract enemies, set traps, and exploit the environment. But when the moon twinkles in hungry eyes and the howls draw nearer, unleash a devastating force.

  • Will you wage a desperate fight for a cache of ammunition, or sneak silently past the snarling sentry?

Woodland Werewolf offers a relentless blend of visceral action and suffocating horror. Feel the crunch of bones beneath your boots, the desperate search for resources, and the paralyzing fear of eyes glowing in the darkness. Will you outwit the beasts, save the innocent, and uncover the source of the werewolf invasion?

content_descriptors.notes: Features violence and gore: characters sustain visible injuries, including bleeding, during combat.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 version 21H1 (build 19043) or newer
  • Processor: x86, x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support, Arm64
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX10, DX11, DX12 or Vulkan capable GPUs
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 version 21H1 (build 19043) or newer
  • Processor: x86, x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support, Arm64
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: DX10, DX11, DX12 or Vulkan capable GPUs
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: The closing days for the season in a woodland resort descend into a savage action horror nightmare. Play as a staff member fighting to protect the guests as intelligent, monstrous werewolves emerge from the ancient woods.

English*, French*, Spanish - Spain*, Spanish - Latin America*, Japanese*, Korean*
*languages with full audio support
